title: Freeway Supercharger yield products become available
description: Freeway offered Supercharger products linked to crypto and fiat assets and advertised annual rewards reaching as high as 43 percent.
notes: The year is approximate and should be replaced by an archived first-party launch date when available.

title: Freeway halts Supercharger buy-backs and withdrawals
description: Freeway stopped Supercharger simulation buy-backs and related platform transactions, preventing customers from exiting the high-yield products.
notes: Freeway described the measure as temporary and initially cited volatility in crypto and foreign-exchange markets.

title: Freeway attributes halt to failed trading strategy and losses
description: Freeway stated that a trading strategy had failed and caused substantial losses, providing a more specific explanation for the withdrawal halt.
notes: The statement was reported through industry publications and should remain linked to archived first-party communications where available.

title: AuBit International seeks Cayman restructuring protection
description: AuBit International petitioned the Cayman Islands court for the appointment of restructuring officers while acknowledging financial distress.
notes: The restructuring application was later dismissed after the court found the proposed plan insufficiently developed.

title: AuBit International enters official liquidation
description: The Grand Court of the Cayman Islands ordered AuBit International into official liquidation and appointed joint official liquidators, ending the viable restructuring path for the company affiliated with Freeway.
notes: The liquidation concerns AuBit International, the company identified by the liquidators as affiliated with the Freeway platform and its Supercharger products.
